source.title: Latent communication between AI models (public technical description)
source.venue: Company web page, not peer reviewed

confidence_rationale: COMPANY-REPORTED, NOT INDEPENDENTLY REPLICATED, NOT PEER REVIEWED. Banked so that the record is explicit rather than absent. The page (fetched 2026-09-08) describes a 'small trained bridge' letting a frozen GLM-5.2 (753B) sender hand hidden states to a Qwen-3.5 (4B) receiver, and reports the small model 'closes 50% of that distance, which lifts its own accuracy by 25%', up to 2x on harder subsets, at 2.5x less compute than a mid-sized model, and up to 10 points over text handoff. No paper, preprint, code, or data is provided for these results; the citations on the page are to interpretability work by others (Hanna & Ameisen ICLR 2026; Lindsey et al. 2025; Gurnee et al. 2026; Korbak et al. 2025), not to a replication. Direction 'unknown' and confidence 0.10 so that it cannot contribute support to any claim; it is motivation only, exactly as ARC-139 and MECH-537's notes require.
failure_signatures: If the Mostik result were independently replicated with frozen endpoints and mismatched-pair controls it would become ARC-139/MECH-538 evidence; until then any citation of it as support is a citation of a marketing page.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Mostik states that 'One model hands its hidden states to another through a small trained bridge, and the receiving model works with them directly', and reports accuracy and cost gains for a GLM-5.2 -> Qwen-3.5-4B pairing. No methodology, controls, or independent evaluation are published.
mapping.ree_translation: Motivation only. The thought package and both affected claims already say this must not be promoted to support, and the pull confirms there is nothing to promote: no artefact exists that could be verified.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Unverifiable. Numbers are company-reported on a web page with no stated protocol. Do not cite as evidence for any claim.
mapping.source_context: Company technical description; frozen GLM-5.2 (753B) sender, Qwen-3.5 (4B) receiver, trained bridge.

confidence_components.notes: Deliberately floored. The entry exists to make the epistemic status explicit in the evidence record, per the chip's special-handling instruction.
